preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 10**5 and 1 <= n <= 10**5 for m, n in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]])
preconditions.description: Input starts with two integers m and n, where 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 10^5, representing the number of split rules and monster types, respectively.
Each split rule line has at least two integers: monster ID and the number of resulting monsters/diamonds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(monster_id) <= n for monster_id in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each split rule's monster ID is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(int(li) >= 1 for li in [line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each split rule has at least one resulting monster or diamond (li ≥ 1).

preconditions.expression: all(-1 in rule or any(int(x) != -1 for x in rule) for rule in [line.split()[2:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each split rule contains at least one diamond (-1) and at least one monster or diamond.

preconditions.expression: all(len(rule) == int(li) + 2 for li, rule in zip([line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [line.split()[2:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if li != '')
preconditions.description: Each split rule's length matches the specified number of resulting monsters/diamonds.

postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two integers: the smallest and largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(monster_id) <= n for monster_id in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Output lines correspond to monster IDs from 1 to n in order.

postconditions.expression: all((min_diamonds == -1 and max_diamonds == -1) or (min_diamonds != -1 and min_diamonds >= 0) or (max_diamonds == -2) for min_diamonds, max_diamonds in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each monster, if no termination is possible, both values are -1. Otherwise, min_diamonds is non-negative or max_diamonds is -2 (arbitrarily large).

postconditions.expression: all(min_diamonds <= max_diamonds for min_diamonds, max_diamonds in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each monster, the smallest number of diamonds is less than or equal to the largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(min_diamonds <= 314000000 and (max_diamonds == -2 or max_diamonds <= 314000000) for min_diamonds, max_diamonds in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: If a number exceeds 314000000, it is capped at 314000000 in the output.

postconditions.expression: all((min_diamonds == -1 and max_diamonds == -1) or (min_diamonds != -1 and max_diamonds != -1 and min_diamonds >= 0 and max_diamonds >= 0) or (min_diamonds != -1 and max_diamonds == -2) for min_diamonds, max_diamonds in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: If termination is possible, both min_diamonds and max_diamonds are non-negative or max_diamonds is -2.
